target.graphic: Straight-set serif ALABAMA (charcoal-heather fill, crimson outline) + circular University of Alabama seal rising behind letters + charcoal ALUMNI ribbon banner below
target.color: MUST be a shade of gray. Ash / light heather ideal; charcoal viable. Hard pass on red/crimson, white, cream/ivory, oatmeal, sand/tan, black — color is gated before graphic.
target.blank: Jerzees Super Sweats (Russell Corp, Alexander City AL, WPL 7332), Made in USA, ~50/50 +5% other fiber
target.size: L or XL only. 42-44 (90s L) ideal; modern L-XL fine. XXL/2XL is a HARD NO as of 2026-09-03 (Drew's direction) - a 2XL wears too big, no exceptions however good the print.
target.priceGuide: 20-50 USD typical comp; up to ~75 for exact match
target.colorRule: Added 2026-08-30 at Drew's direction: a non-gray sweatshirt is not a viable option regardless of how exact the print is. Non-gray items may be logged as documentation comps but never surfaced as candidates.
target.sizeRule: Added 2026-09-03: only L and XL are entertained. XXL/2XL items may be logged as documentation of a print family but never surfaced as candidates or dossier cards.

channels.notes: Facebook Marketplace unblocked 2026-08-30 when Drew signed the Chrome profile into Facebook. FB relevance collapses under sortBy=creation_time_descend — use default (suggested) sort, and sweep local pickup separately from shipping. | 2026-08-31: FB image srcs are unreadable from JS (blocked) — screenshot the results grid instead. Etsy/eBay/Depop/Grailed/Poshmark grids are best eyeballed by injecting a labeled grid into a live marketplace tab (file:// previews render as static snapshots and never load images). | 2026-09-03: Mercari DID render in the in-app Claude Browser this run (item titles live in the card , not the anchor text) — the 'real Chrome only' note is no longer absolute. Facebook was the only blocked channel. Verify eBay liveness with the JSON-LD schema.org availability string, NOT innerText phrase matching — eBay's inline scripts contain both 'This listing has ended' and 'Buy It Now' on every page and produce false positives either way. | 2026-09-07: Mercari, Depop, Grailed, Poshmark and Etsy all rendered fine in the in-app Claude Browser; only Facebook was blocked (extension offline). Image-grid eyeballing must render at scrollY 0 in ONE viewport - the in-app pane does not paint below the fold and returns blank screenshots, and computer{action:'zoom'} region-cropping is not supported there, so magnify by rendering a single oversized inside an overflow:hidden div instead. Search-result thumbnails desaturate: etsy:4538672718 read gray in the grid and is maroon at full size. eBay liveness via a cross-origin fetch of the item page + regex on the JSON-LD availability string works and is cheap - seven ids in one call. | 2026-09-10: eBay, Etsy, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Grailed and the AlabamaVTG products.json sweep all rendered in the in-app Claude Browser; only Facebook was blocked. Two gotchas re-confirmed: (a) an injected extractor function does NOT survive navigation, so inline the whole extractor in every javascript_tool call rather than stashing it on window; (b) Etsy listing pages cannot be read by cross-origin fetch (returns an ~800-byte stub) - navigate to the listing to check liveness, while eBay JSON-LD availability via cross-origin fetch works fine and checked five ids in one call. eBay 318838769762 went OutOfStock three days after listing, so the correct blank at ~$18 sells inside a week: sweep newest-first more often than twice weekly. | 2026-09-14: FACEBOOK UNBLOCKED for the first time since Aug 30 - the claude-in-chrome extension reported one connected local browser and the Chrome profile was still signed in to Facebook, so shipping (radius=805) and local-pickup (radius=161) both swept clean. Two FB gotchas: (a) a /marketplace/search URL without an explicit radius silently collapses to the profile's home city within 60 mi and returns 'No listings found' even for queries that have hits - always pass radius; (b) the empty-state copy keeps saying 'within 60 miles' even after the radius filter visibly updates, so trust the filter rail, not the message. Also: an Etsy search URL with &order=date_desc can return a hard zero for a query that returns 64 results without it - drop the sort before concluding a term is dead. All ten channels rendered in the in-app Claude Browser except Facebook, which needs real Chrome. | 2026-09-17: eBay, Etsy, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Grailed, AlabamaVTG and Facebook (both shipping radius=805 and local pickup radius=161) all swept - zero blocked channels for the second run running. Three gotchas worth keeping: (a) a cross-origin fetch of an eBay item page only works from a tab whose origin IS ebay.com - the same call from a grailed.com tab throws on every id, so navigate to an eBay page before batch-checking liveness; (b) Depop search thumbnails come back as blurry lazy-load placeholders and the P0.jpg full-size variant 404s, so judge Depop off the card alt text (it states color and gender) or open the listing, never off the grid image; (c) the in-app pane needs ~3-4s after injecting an image grid before the screenshot has pixels in it - screenshotting immediately returns labels on white. | 2026-09-21: eBay/Etsy/Poshmark/Mercari/Depop/Grailed/AlabamaVTG all rendered in the in-app Claude Browser. Facebook is signed in and sweepable for SHIPPING, but the account's Marketplace location is set to Hamden CT - the /marketplace/birmingham/ slug resolves to Birmingham UK and /marketplace/tuscaloosa/ silently falls back to Hamden, so the Alabama LOCAL-PICKUP sweep is not reachable by URL. Changing it means editing the account's location setting, which this run did not do. FB search-grid JS extraction returns {} (blocked) - use find{query} to get a ref and click through for ids, and read tiles off a full-resolution screenshot, not a 0.6 scale one. eBay liveness via cross-origin fetch only works from an ebay.com origin tab; curl is blocked outright. | 2026-09-24: all channels swept (eBay, Etsy, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Grailed, AlabamaVTG, FB shipping via Chrome, web index); zero blocked. eBay _ipg=120 pulls ~500 unseen older ids across six queries because previous runs only logged opened listings - filter by title regex (gray/seal/russell/jerzees, drop tees/hoodies/2XL) before eyeballing. Homefield's product .js endpoint (/products/.js) answers cross-origin and gives per-variant availability in one call. FB 'vintage alabama alumni sweatshirt' returned zero with shipping radius 805; the broader 'vintage alabama sweatshirt' is the useful FB query. | 2026-09-28: all channels swept (eBay 6 queries incl. 'russell alabama sweatshirt', Etsy x2, Poshmark x2, Mercari x2, Depop, Grailed, AlabamaVTG 557 products, FB shipping via Chrome, web index); zero blocked. Poshmark search-card images lazy-load blank and JSON-LD isn't present on listing HTML via fetch — use og:image from a same-origin fetch of each listing instead. Poshmark 'vintage alabama crewneck' + department=Men is far more useful than the 'alumni' query. Seller color words cut both ways: the FOTL elephant-A patch was listed 'off white' and reads light ash heather in the close-up. | 2026-10-01: all channels swept (eBay 6 queries, Etsy x2, Poshmark x3, Mercari x2, Depop, Grailed, AlabamaVTG 559 products, FB shipping via Chrome, web index); zero blocked. Fast path that worked: from one ebay.com tab, same-origin fetch() each search URL and DOMParser the HTML - six queries in one call - with the seen ids stashed in localStorage (survives navigation, unlike window.*). Poshmark search pages fetch the same way. Etsy search via fetch only returns ~12 cards; navigate instead. Title-regex traps: /t-?shirt/ matches 'sweaTSHIRT', /champ/ matches 'Champion', and \bs\b matches the s in "90's"/"Men's" - each silently dropped most of the list. This run logged every title-screened id (not just opened ones) so the unseen pile should stop regrowing. | 2026-10-05: all channels swept (eBay 6 queries via same-origin fetch+DOMParser from one tab, Etsy x3 (one DataDome blank fixed by homepage re-warm), Poshmark x3 via fetch, Mercari x2 in-app, Depop, Grailed, AlabamaVTG 598 products, FB shipping via Chrome, web index x2); zero blocked. Poshmark gotcha: every listing page contains the literal boilerplate 'Not For Sale' - liveness must be read from the JSON-LD availability field, never from innerText/banner regex; a sloppy regex marked three live cards SOLD this run before the availability check corrected it. Tultex XL reference-layout cousin dropped $41 to $29 on Poshmark. Etsy second search in a row returned a blank body (DataDome) - re-warm via homepage and use a fresh query string. | 2026-10-08: all channels swept (eBay 6 queries via same-origin fetch+DOMParser from one in-app tab, Etsy x3 by navigation, Poshmark x3 via fetch, Mercari x2 in-app, Depop + Grailed via Chrome, AlabamaVTG 599 products via curl, FB shipping radius=805 + radius=161 via Chrome, web index x2); zero blocked. Gotchas: (a) the in-app javascript_tool result is DOUBLE-encoded JSON when large (a JSON string containing JSON) and gets written to a tool-results file with a trailing "(captured at origin ...)" line - strip it before json.loads; (b) the Chrome extension javascript_tool truncates output around 600 chars - return ids only, in halves, and filter against the seen list inside the page; (c) localStorage is per-origin, so a seen-set stashed on ebay.com is invisible on etsy.com - re-inject per site; (d) curl to ebay.com/itm returns an Error Page even with a browser UA - liveness must go through a browser tab; (e) Etsy il_794xN image variants do not always exist, il_570xN always does; (f) AlabamaVTG products.json carries the available flag, the single-product .json does not. Four new gray cousins carded: Russell seal-in-A XL (eBay), Hanes Beefy elephant-A XL (Mercari), laurel-crest L and charcoal elephant-A XL (Poshmark). Dead this run: ash full-color seal XL (eBay 377279857609) and the AlabamaVTG Gear charcoal M/L. | 2026-10-12: all channels swept (eBay 6 queries via same-origin fetch from in-app tab, Etsy x3 by navigation, Poshmark x4 via fetch, Mercari x2 in-app, Depop, Grailed, AlabamaVTG 710 products via curl, FB shipping radius=805 via Chrome, web index x2); zero blocked. Gotchas: (a) the first in-app tab hung on ebay.com and every javascript_tool call timed out even for location.href - closing it and opening a fresh tab fixed it; (b) Promise.all of six eBay search fetches exceeds the 45s tool timeout if awaited - kick it off in setTimeout, write to localStorage, read back in a second call; (c) Poshmark search-card src is lazy and empty in DOMParser output - pull og:image from each listing page via fetch instead; (d) a removed Poshmark listing returns the homepage title with an "availability":"available" string from unrelated page JSON - navigate and read "no longer available" rather than trusting a fetch regex; (e) chrome-extension localStorage on facebook.com came back null between calls - inline the seen list instead. | 2026-10-15: eBay (6 queries via same-origin fetch+DOMParser from one in-app tab, 163 unseen ids), Etsy x3 by navigation, Poshmark x4 via fetch (106 unseen), Mercari x2 in-app, Depop (card alt text), Grailed, AlabamaVTG products.json via curl (now 330 products, down from 710 - catalog purged), web index x2. BLOCKED: Facebook - the claude-in-chrome extension reported not connected on two tries, so FB was not swept and the Birmingham Champion L is unverified. Gotchas: (a) the in-app pane reports innerWidth/innerHeight 0 from JS - size image grids in fixed px, never from the viewport; (b) Mercari thumbnail src is /photos/_1.jpg - do not rewrite the suffix, it 404s; (c) Grailed listing pages give price, size and description from innerText after ~2s and the gallery srcs are usable at /c_limit,w_800/; (d) a Poshmark fetch that returns the homepage og:title means the listing was removed (confirmed by navigation: 'no longer available'). Two liked-print cousins carded (charcoal Delta L on Poshmark $25, gray Russell L on Grailed $45) plus a gray Jerzees-by-Russell 42-44 USA plain-arch L on eBay $35 as a right-blank cousin. Dead: Galt Sand elephant-A back gray L (eBay + Poshmark) and the Lee Sport elephant-A XL. | 2026-10-19: all channels swept, zero blocked - Facebook back (claude-in-chrome connected, profile signed in; FB javascript_tool href extraction worked this time, so ids came straight from a[href*='/marketplace/item/'] with the seen list inlined). eBay 6 queries (574 ids, 140 unseen) via same-origin fetch+DOMParser in setTimeout -> localStorage, read back after 20s. Poshmark 4 queries x (Men, all) via fetch (111 unseen). Etsy x3 by navigation; Mercari x2 in-app; Depop via same-origin fetch of /products// for og:image + meta description (size/price only on the rendered page - screenshot it); Grailed; AlabamaVTG products.json via curl (491 products, logged all 457 unseen ids this run so the pile stops regrowing). Gotchas: (a) the in-app pane is ~800px wide - image grids wider than ~6x128px get cut off on the right; (b) the eBay J&M crest cousin 257778070671 went OutOfStock and reappeared as relist 257802791600 at the same price - a cousin 'dying' can be a relist, search the title before moving it to sold; (c) Depop search sort=newlyListed is ignored in the URL (redirects to relevance) - nearly all 24 results were unseen anyway. | 2026-10-22: all channels except Facebook swept (Chrome extension not connected on three tries). New fast path for getting big extractor output into Python: the in-app javascript_tool saves any result over the token limit to a tool-results file, so return JSON.stringify(data)+'#PAD#'+'x'.repeat(180000) and parse the file (outer JSON string, strip the '(captured at origin' trailer, split on #PAD#) - no need to inline the seen list into the page. A localhost CORS server does NOT work: ebay.com's CSP blocks fetch to 127.0.0.1. Dead this run: the Depop Lee Sport seal+ribbon L (eBay copy 960077349003 still live). Grailed Russell elephant-A L 89585629 dropped $45->$40; Etsy laurel XL 4461167693 back to $72. | 2026-10-29: Etsy search returned a bare 429 on the first try even after a homepage warm-up; a second homepage visit then the search (without order=date_desc) worked. Depop P10.jpg thumbs are tiny - swap to P0.jpg (1280px) for eyeballing. eBay item specifics are readable from a same-origin fetch via DOMParser '.ux-labels-values' (brand/size/color) - quicker than navigating.
